title: Changes to Department of Labor Media Lockup
主要内容: The U.S. Department of Labor announced on January 16, 2020, that it will permanently discontinue media lock-ups for all releases starting June 3, 2020, regardless of ongoing pandemic-related restrictions. This decision follows earlier suspensions due to the COVID-19 pandemic, which were temporary measures to protect staff and reporters. The DOL emphasized that this change represents a permanent policy shift, not a temporary adjustment. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and the Department of Labor’s Employment and Training Administration (ETA) will continue to release data to the public immediately at 8:30 AM Eastern Time. The discontinuation of the media lock-up aligns with the Office of Management and Budget guidance, ensuring equitable and timely dissemination. The DOL Inspector General has raised concerns about the lock-up process, noting it may create an unfair competitive advantage for certain news organizations. These entities can profit by selling high-speed data feeds to traders for algorithmic trading.
